title: Magic
description: A mod that add magic to the game. Like magic wands and spells. Spells can be inserted into magic wands which when used will perform the spell inserted
body:
# Magic

It add magic wands to minecraft. The wands can execute varius spells

## What does it add?

- 2 Wands
- Wand charger
- Wand spell changer
- Varius spells (You can get them from villagers)

## Supported languages

- English (99%)
- Italian (100%)
- Spanish (99%)

#### Note: the mod is discontinued
